gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-syriac-ea: Noto Sans Syriac Eastern reads friendly and current, its lowercase running large against small caps and its curve endings keeping well apart. Mystery Quest supplies the bookish nostalgia; the sans keeps the text moving.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Bookish and nostalgic, yet clean: Mystery Quest wears compact ascenders while Noto Sans Tagalog lets its middle zone dominate the line. The display face sets the mood; the sans carries the sentences.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Mystery Quest leaves every curved stroke gaping open, with compact ascenders perched above its lowercase. But Noto Sans Tagbanwa does the reading best, with clear gaps in its curves and lowercase filling most of the height.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Chalkboard lowercase, crowded high: Noto Sans Tai Tham presses up toward the capital line, yet every c stays clearly visible. Mystery Quest does its best work big and brief, with bookish nostalgia.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-tai-viet: Bookish up top, approachable below: Mystery Quest brings nostalgia while Noto Sans Tai Viet pulls its terminals back. And with short ascenders and a high middle band, the body text can happily drop a size.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-takri: Mystery Quest cuts a gap into each curved stroke, its compact ascenders sitting over a high lowercase. And Noto Sans Takri, with its high-waisted lowercase, can sit at a modest size beneath the heading.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Noto Sans Tamil looks magnified without growing, its terminals stopping far from the stem and its sans-serif letters feeling thoroughly contemporary. Mystery Quest lends bookish nostalgia up front while this one carries the text.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-tamil-sup: Contemporary and clean, Noto Sans Tamil Supplement draws round forms like open parentheses. Mystery Quest leads with bookish, nostalgic character and compact ascenders, while the sans packs the line with a stocky middle band.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-tc: Mystery Quest cuts open every curved stroke and tucks compact ascenders over its lowercase, giving headings a bookish, nostalgic look. Noto Sans TC then carries the text, its curves opening outward.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Mystery Quest is a bookish, nostalgic display face whose compact ascenders sit over a lowercase with open curved strokes. And Noto Sans Telugu, with its high-set midline, is happy at a modest size.
